item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Since this thread was on page 6 of the forum listing with no responses, this is a quick staff reminder to the author that if you haven't yet, you should contact reviewers directly to request feedback as needed.

Please refer to this thread for more information: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

If you have already reached out to multiple reviewers and received no reply, notify a staff member for assistance finding a reviewer.

item.title: Anomalous Chime Seeking Greenlight.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP

Genre (Optional): Light-Hearted/Comedic

Page Layout (Optional): Standard (Modern Header)

Elevator Pitch: A Specialty shop in Southern FL is producing clock's who's chimes enamor the listener. (Note, the clocks, not the shop are the SCP). For obvious reasons the foundation is is forced to get involved. Page in its entirety is not absurdly long (1300 words).

Central Narrative: A Safe SCP, with normal containment. The meat of the page is two testing logs (controlled/non-controlled) and a summary of the recovery for said SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Each chime is special, just to you…

Additional Notes: I have a full draft in the sandbox, please message if you would like to read it. (I'm not supposed to post sandbox links out-right).
